lines: Lane i-nominee-requests, review-13 fix round (rule 53). Not pushed, not landed, not rebased.
Commits: 73b91e4 feat(nominee), 0fce13c feat(nominee-ui) (builder), 0770454 fix (review-6), and a5b8313 fix(nominee): keep the nominee out of the admin decision receipt (review-13).

Finding 1 (MEDIUM) fixed by the review's recommended route: accept and decline now answer {request} only. adminNomineeRequestRoutes decisionBody takes the row alone; NomineeDecision drops holder and lockPending returns the request row (the nominee row is still locked first, same lock order). Contract AdminNomineeDecisionData is {request: AdminNomineeRequest}; openapi-v1.json and .d.ts regenerated; frontend generate:api emitted 197 operations with no diff (operations.ts names descriptors, not shapes). useDecideNomineeRequest drops the onSuccess setQueryData; onSettled still invalidates qk.admin.user(userId), which covers userNominee. The admin decision receipt now holds only request.nominee, which nomineeObject scrubs in both releases.

Readers checked (STATIC, git grep): ClientNomineeRequestPanel reads only decision.request; no frontend test, e2e or doc read the removed field; adminNomineeRoutes direct-change receipt keeps the flat {userId, nominee:{name,relation}, version, status} shape, which is scrubbed.

Finding 1 test: nomineeRequests.integration.test.ts accept test now asserts Object.keys(response data) equals ['request'] and checks nominee_version 2 in users instead of the response. Red control 20261116T132244Z-2591387: a nominee key put back in decisionBody failed it (1 failed, 5 passed); reverted from the index before the green runs.
Not done (optional, review's alternative route): no decision-shaped receipt was added to the erasureSupport.ts seed; the G2 'no nominee readable' sweep still seeds only the flat receipt shape.

Finding 2 fixed in client-erasure.md 'Rollback after 072': the G2 bullet covers a verified client or one with money rows, drops 'every nominee object', says v0.16.2 still scrubs request.nominee in decision receipts, and names the gap as any text v0.16.2 scrubs by name (audit reason_detail and metadata, application review text, support tickets, notifications, ledger, maturity, payout and receipt notes, JSON values equal to the name).

Finding 3 fixed in client-erasure.md: the 'in JSON' bullet (line 58) says emails as in text but a phone only in its stored +91 form, whole-value names, and name/relation directly under a nominee key; nested objects, national-format phones and names inside sentences are not replaced. The receipt paragraph (line 116) says the receipt holds only the request, request.nominee and clientName are replaced, and a national-format number or a name inside the decline reason stays readable; it no longer claims this matches DEC-29 and marks it worth the maintainer's review. The idempotency table row names nominee request decisions.

For the maintainer (not raised as a question): a national-format phone typed into a decline reason survives erasure in the admin receipt in both releases; DEC-29 reads 'emails and phones erased everywhere'.

Finding 4, corrected wording of the paging residual (supersedes the review-6 handoff line): the queue cursor keeps asOf, but a request withdrawn by erasure gets decided_at = now(), the erasure transaction's start time, so for that row the window is the whole erasure transaction, not milliseconds. Rows only move from the waiting group to the decided group and the waiting group is paged first, so nothing is skipped; a row can repeat once (pending on page 1, Tombstoned later). Admin view only.

Finding 5 fixed: NomineeDecisionForm hint now reads 'The client sees this reason in the app, and in the email while the account is active.' The form also shows for closed accounts (decline only), and informClient queues mail only for active, untombstoned clients, so the caveat is needed for the hint to be true. The 0770454 commit body's 'queue ranked by state alone' red control was temporary and uncommitted, as the review-6 handoff said.
Review-13 note accepted: the carried legal-hold point is moot; legal_holds_entity_type_check (012) does not allow client_nominee_request in either release.

Not verified: no browser, device or APK run; no real erasure against a v0.16.2 image; receipt contents after erasure are STATIC from the scrubber code.

Commits: 73b91e4 feat(nominee): migration 072, backend, contracts, regenerated OpenAPI and frontend operations, erasure doc; 0fce13c feat(nominee-ui): profile request UI and admin queue, tile and client-page decisions.

Migration 072_client_nominee_requests.sql: expand-only. New table client_nominee_requests (063 text checks as \u escapes, state pending/accepted/declined/withdrawn, decline reason 1-500 chars single line, decided_by/at, version, partial unique index one pending per client), tombstone triggers mirroring 067, email_deliveries_template_check = every 068 key + nominee_request_decided (no sip_early_exit). The previous release runs against it: it ignores the table and every key it writes is still allowed. Release note: an old email worker would permanently fail nominee_request_decided mail (finding-26), so deploy workers with the API.

Q-042: POST /v1/client/profile/nominee now answers AUTHORIZATION_DENIED (403) after authenticating; released apps show it under 'Nominee not saved' as 'This account can't do that.' GET is unchanged. Added the code to the changeClientNominee contract (error codes are not checked per operation, finding-14).

Client ops (client-nominee-requests.ts): GET /v1/client/nominee-requests/latest, POST /v1/client/nominee-requests (currentPassword, shared passwordRecheckLimiter, idempotency key, hash excludes the password), POST /v1/client/nominee-requests/{id}/withdraw (expectedVersion). A second pending send is STATE_CONFLICT.

Admin ops (admin-nominee-requests.ts), read users.read and decide clients.create as the admin nominee route (DEC-36): GET /v1/admin/nominee-requests (pending first, then newest; state filter), GET /v1/admin/overview/nominee-requests (pendingCount, oldestPendingAt; its own endpoint like pending-invites), GET /v1/admin/users/{id}/nominee-requests, POST .../accept (expectedVersion, expectedNomineeVersion) and .../decline (expectedVersion, reason|null). Accept locks user then request and calls changeClientNominee in the same transaction.

Audit commands: nominee_request.sent / .withdrawn (actor user), nominee_request.accepted / .declined (actor admin), names masked. Decision: notification kind nominee_request_decided (new string kind, payload nomineeRequestId, decision, deepLink /profile; old apps show plain title/body) and nominee_request_decided email v1 in its own module (emailTemplateParts.ts registry, one-line registration) with a send guard re-checking email revision, account state and request state.
Routes register through runtime/nomineeComposition.ts; the client and admin nominee routes moved there out of composition.ts and adminComposition.ts.

Erasure: G2 trigger tombstones name/relation, nulls the reason and withdraws a pending request; requested names join the scrubber's names; G3 deletes rows; inspect lists client_nominee_request entities; coverage test classifies the table; release_manager/docs/client-erasure.md updated.

Corrected from the stopped runs: 072 had literal invisible characters (including U+2028) in its regexes; replaced with the \u escapes 063 uses. Added nominee_request_decided to releaseUpgrade's accepted keys and client_nominee_requests to its empty-tables list. Frontend was not started; built here.

Checks (Node 22 container, logs in .temp/tally/logs/i-nominee-requests/): contracts npm run check 7 files 98 tests (20261116T120626Z-978010); backend npm run check 101 files 1204 tests (20261116T120755Z-995506); backend test:integration --coverage.enabled=false 71 files 578 tests (20261116T120935Z-1030378); frontend check at commit 1 40 files 336 tests (20261116T120929Z-1027855); frontend check at commit 2 40 files 336 tests (20261116T121810Z-1349779); build:client 17 assets 940480 bytes (20261116T121908Z-1381486); build:admin (20261116T121915Z-1387404).

Red evidence (each mutation reverted, logs *-red.log at 20261116T1212..1213 and 20261116T1217): unique index removed -> direct second pending insert accepted; pending pre-check and ON CONFLICT removed -> race gives 500 not 409; version/state checks removed -> concurrent decisions [200,500] not [200,409]; withdraw ownership check removed -> other client withdraws; decide permission removed -> support/finance not 403; refusing POST route removed -> 404 not 403; erasure delete removed -> G3 erase fails; requested names not scrubbed -> G2 copies readable; coverage classification removed -> coverage test fails; send hook as a plain mutation -> credential test finds the password in the cache.

Unrun control: atomicity of accept (nominee set + request closed or neither) is tested with a trigger forcing the close to fail, but no mutation could make it non-atomic inside one transaction; disclosed.

Tally: M15-nominee-requests:N1-nominee-requests is on track main, so task_claim and every runner result were refused (results under the worktree .temp/tally/results/refused/); note-72 asks the coordinator to move it. No evidence is recorded in tally yet.

Defaults taken: queue default filter is All with waiting first; decisions happen on the client page, the queue links there; decline reason is a single-line input (DB forbids line breaks); accept is disabled for a closed account, decline stays; client cannot request removal (DEC-39 says name and relation); notification uses a new string kind rather than reusing another feature's kind, reading finding-14 as allowing new kinds.
Not verified: no browser, device or APK run of the new screens; no real mail sent (email only rendered and dispatched to the test transport in integration); no review yet (rule-53).

Commits: 73b91e4 feat(nominee) and 0fce13c feat(nominee-ui) (builder), plus fix 0770454 fix(nominee): send the decline reason by email and steady queue paging.

MEDIUM 1 (DEC-51) fixed: the decline reason travels in the sealed payload (nomineeRequestDecidedMail declineReason, only when non-null) and nominee_request_decided v1 renders 'The reason the team gave: <reason>' as an escaped text block, or 'The team did not give a reason.'. Template version stays v1 (unreleased). Send guard unchanged: it still re-checks email revision, account state, tombstone, request owner and decided state. Sealed payloads are already scrubbed (G2) or deleted (G3) by erasure; the doc row now names decline reasons.

MEDIUM 1 copy: ClientNomineeRequestPanel says the client is told in the app, and by email while the account is active (informClient only queues mail for active, untombstoned clients), with the reason if given; NomineeDecisionForm hint says the reason shows in the app and in the email.

MEDIUM 1 test: the existing decline test in nomineeRequests.integration.test.ts now dispatches the decision mail and asserts the text carries the reason and the HTML escapes '<as on their ID>'; the accept test shares the new deliverDecisionMail helper. Red control 20261116T130027Z-2206022: reason left out of the sealed payload -> text assertion fails; reverted.

MEDIUM 2 recorded (no code): client-erasure.md, after the 069 rollback-boundary paragraph, 'Rollback after 072'. (a) After an images-only rollback to v0.16.2, its G3 erase of a never-verified client with any nominee request deletes the user row without deleting client_nominee_requests; the 072 ON DELETE RESTRICT key fails it with a foreign-key error, answered 500; the transaction rolls back, nothing lost or half-erased, but that client cannot be erased until roll-forward. (b) Its G2 scrubber does not know the requested names: the 072 trigger still tombstones the requests, nulls the reason and withdraws a pending one, and v0.16.2 replaces every JSON 'nominee' object (receipts), but a requested name that never became the nominee stays readable where the client's free text quotes it (support tickets, notifications, notes); a later erase answers already_erased and does not rescrub.
Correction to the builder handoff: 'the previous release runs against 072' holds except for these two erasure limits.

LOW 3 fixed by reading the field: useDecideNomineeRequest onSuccess sets qk.admin.userNominee(userId) to decision.nominee (same NomineeData shape as getAdminUserNominee); the route and contract are unchanged.

LOW 4 recorded: client-erasure.md says a decline reason survives in both paths inside the admin decision's idempotency receipt; the receipt scrub replaces contacts, whole-value names and nominee objects only (emails and phones inside the reason are replaced), matching DEC-29.

LOW 5 fixed: the queue cursor now carries asOf (the first page's clock time) as its first value; rank is 0 for state pending or decided_at > asOf, so a row decided between page loads keeps its place (shown with its new state) instead of repeating. Residual: a decision whose transaction began before and committed after the first page's read, within milliseconds, can still repeat once. Verified with a temporary, uncommitted three-request paging test: green 20261116T125955Z-2196101 with the fix, red 20261116T130007Z-2199220 with rank by current state (4 rows seen for 3); the test was removed (rule 10: paging is not an expensive failure).
Nit fixed: double blank line in ClientNomineeRequestPanel.tsx removed.
